lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+5.5% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test stopped early (-8.3% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (+0.7% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, though round 11 was an exception.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Companion Path Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story and path selection flow into a full-bleed story scroll layout with interactive decision cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514 seconds, showing confusion or hesitation early in the funnel.

story.headline: Embark on Your Desktop Pet Journey
story.body: Explore different companion paths tailored to your workspace style.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Experience
choose_path.body: Choose whether you want a pre-built pet friend or a custom pet companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns story and choose_path layouts while preserving all required screen functions and onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and high mean time at choose_path, but redesigns have mixed history.

candidates.title: Multi Provider Auth Button Grid Layout
candidates.change: Reorganizes sign-in options into a clean two-column grid layout with highlighted provider buttons.
candidates.why: Sign-in converts at 72.9% and support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to load clearly.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to sync your pet settings across devices.

guard.reason: Reorganizes sign-in buttons into a two-column grid within onboarding without losing screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel drop-off and support tickets confirm sign-in confusion and failures.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet personality quiz screen before pet selection to help users find their ideal companion match.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep 35.3% drop-off rate and takes an average of 1017 seconds, pointing to friction in pet decision making.

new_pet_quiz.headline: What Kind of Companion Do You Need?
new_pet_quiz.body: Answer 3 quick questions to get matched with your perfect desktop pet personality.

guard.reason: Adds a new pet personality quiz screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps intact.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off but adding extra screens risks increasing friction based on prior data.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Activity Log Progress Info
candidates.change: Adds animated progress status bars and explicit backend pet rendering estimates to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336 seconds (median 201s), leaving users unsure if pet creation is working.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Companion...
waiting.body: We are assembling 3D assets and animations for your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adds real progress info and time estimates to the waiting screen as allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean wait time creates user drop-off; clear activity progress addresses lingering uncertainty.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Playground Flow
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive testing screen where users practice summoning, hiding, and talking to their pet before arriving home.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet on the desktop.

new_pet_playground.headline: Try Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_playground.body: Test dragging, minimizing, and chatting with your pet right now.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive playground screen before home intro while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence for post-onboarding pet control confusion; finish new_flow showed positive early lift.

candidates.title: Post Story Path Sign In Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign_in step to occur immediately after the initial story screen and before choose_path.
candidates.why: Prompting sign-in early secures user authentication before they spend time customizing pet paths and adoption options.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Photo Lighting and Angle Capture Hint
candidates.change: Displays specific guidance hints on the photo upload screen recommending clear front lighting and neutral backgrounds.
candidates.why: Support logs contain emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pet models.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit photos facing forward for best 3D pet generation results.

guard.reason: Adds photo capture guidance to the upload_photos screen without altering steps or pricing.

candidates.score_note: High impact step backed by support emails on generation failures; low implementation cost via hints.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness System Tray Notification
candidates.change: Enables system tray notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Because waiting times average over 38 minutes (2336s), users switch away and need an alert when setup finishes.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Almost Ready!
waiting.body: You can minimize this window. We'll send a notification when your desktop pet is ready.

guard.reason: Enables a system tray notification option on the waiting screen within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long waiting screen duration by enabling re-engagement notifications.

candidates.title: Companion Path Outcome Clarity Headline
candidates.change: Reword the choose_path headline and body text to clearly describe the outcome and estimated time of each path.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a median of 8s but mean of 514s, indicating confusion over what each option provides.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Creation Path
choose_path.body: Pick Instant Adoption to start immediately with a standard pet (1 min), or Custom Creator to build your own from photos (3 mins).

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy to clarify outcomes while maintaining options for adopting and making your own.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy fix to resolve choose_path confusion and high average dwell time.

candidates.title: First Day Companion Unlock Badge
candidates.change: Displays a celebratory companion milestone badge on the home intro welcome screen upon completing setup.
candidates.why: 20.6% of users drop off at the final step; a rewarding milestone visual increases motivation to complete final onboarding.
